mathematical_contract.quadratic_cusp: For a polynomial-quadratic source, the selected parallel cusp equation is reduced to K(t)+S(t)^(3/2)=0. A candidate is retained only on the selected K<0 branch; then S(t)=cuberoot(K(t)^2) and the resulting quadratic equation is solved exactly over canonical Real. Every candidate is replayed against the original cusp identity before publication.
mathematical_contract.cusp_join: When consecutive offset spans meet at the represented old cusp with structurally opposite limiting offset vectors, the round-join authority constructs the exact certified semicircle. It does not sample, fit, or infer a finite tolerance turn.
mathematical_contract.tangent_deflation: Known construction tangencies are divided from supporting-line and supporting-circle incidence polynomials with their authored multiplicity. A residual root that coincides with the certified parameter replaces its representation with the exact construction witness and remains nontransverse; residual multiplicity can never turn a tangent into a crossing.
mathematical_contract.rational_image: For a retained rational curve restricted by an algebraic source parameter, the quotient-ring multiplication matrices encode N-uD modulo the source polynomial. A local dyadic interval determinant is converted exactly from power to Bernstein form. One sign variation, nonzero endpoints, a certified nonzero global leading coefficient, and the selected image interval together prove one simple image root before constructing BezierParameterPolynomial evidence.
mathematical_contract.native_circle: Retained conic provenance is parameterization-independent. Degree elevation and general rational storage recover the same minor circular image through exact two-chart inversion; native arc dispatch reuses the operation batch cache and falls back to the complete general authority on any unproved precondition.
mathematical_contract.policy: STRICT and APPROXIMATE_512 retain identical exact cusp points, curve carriers, contact multiplicities, and region topology. APPROXIMATE_512 remains available only for an otherwise unresolved final equality/sign decision and never substitutes 512-bit coordinates for canonical Real geometry.
